register_abstraction_config: register a mephisto abstraction config node into the hydra config store under a named group
build_default_task_config: build a default task config dataclass with a specified conf name in the defaults list
initialize_named_configs: initialize and register the base mephisto config structure into the hydra config store
register_script_config: register a script config module into the hydra config store after checking hydra compatibility
parse_arg_dict: parse a dict of arguments into an OmegaConf DictConfig using a customizable class ArgsClass
